about: Layer-2 regression set for agentj/privacy.py (criteria: agentj/privacy_criteria.md). Each draft goes through layer 1 first (no machine identity), then Jev; expect = what Jev should decide on the layer-1 output. Leaky cases leak only what regex cannot see (names, addresses, internal names, business data, surviving codes). Offline tests check the shape; `python3 -m agentj.privacy --eval` runs them live (paid, opt-in). {{fake:<name>}} is expanded by load_cases() from privacy.FAKE_SECRETS, so this file holds no secret-shaped literal.

layer1.about: P127: deterministic layer-1 cases for the path-aware high-entropy rule (privacy.redact(..., paths=True), the owner channel: shared.public_text). A path is judged segment by segment, so a session UUID or a capitalised file name never swallows the whole path; a key-shaped segment, or a slash-bearing base64 secret that is not a path, is still redacted. Strict mode (feedback / plaza, mirrors worker/src/scan.ts) is unchanged. keep = substrings that must survive; gone = substrings that must not.
